item.title: 42nd Annual Gratitude Dinner — Grateful in the Desert!
item.description:
The 42nd Annual Gratitude Dinner — Grateful in the Desert! — featuring speaker Kay S. of Sherman Oaks, CA.

Fellowship ~ Raffles ~ Live Music

Tickets: $70.00 — reserved seating in tables of 12. Scholarship purchases are available to support newcomers.

Online ticket sales: www.aainthedesert.org

A fundraiser hosted by your AA Central Office Intergroup Committee.

item.title: Practicing Principles
item.description: A workshop with speakers and open discussion, focused on practicing the principles in all our affairs. Free raffle and light lunch! Hosted by GSRs of District 10.

item.title: 2026 Pacific Regional Forum
item.description:
Join us for the 2026 Pacific Regional Forum, December 4–6 at the Wyndham San Diego Bayside.

Registration opens Friday, October 2, 2026.

Room Rate: $229.00/night — last day to book: November 4, 2026. Book online at book.passkey.com/go/go/2026AAWS (Group Code: AA022026SD).

Phone: (800) 996-3426 — mention “Alcoholics Anonymous World Services.”

item.title: ACYPAA 54
item.description:
The 54th All California Young People in Alcoholics Anonymous (ACYPAA) convention — “State of Mental Goose Flesh” (pg. 54) — comes to the Delta Marriott Hotel in Ontario, April 15–18, 2027.

Featuring:

  • AA Meetings
  • DJ Sets
  • Yoga
  • Games
  • And more!

ASL & Spanish interpretations available.

More info:

  • Website: www.acypaa.org
  • Instagram: @acypaa54
